name: set off fireworks
about: The avatar points up, colourful firework rockets shoot from its hands into the sky and burst into sparkly bangs, then it cheers as the sparks fade.
code:
const cols = args.color ? [args.color, args.color, 'white'] : ['red', 'gold', 'deepskyblue', 'hotpink', 'lime']
me.feel('happy')
yield* me.poseTo({ armL: { swing: 2.9 }, armR: { swing: 2.9 }, head: { nod: -0.5 } }, 0.3)
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  const hand = i % 2 ? 'left' : 'right'
  const h = me.handAt(hand)
  const c = w.pick(cols)
  w.sound('whoosh')
  const top = 7 + w.random() * 3
  const dx = (w.random() - 0.5) * 4, dz = (w.random() - 0.5) * 4
  yield* w.during(0.6, (k) => {
    w.puff({ x: h.x + dx * k, y: h.y + (top - h.y) * k, z: h.z + dz * k, kind: 'spark', color: c, count: 2, size: 0.1, speed: 0.3, life: 0.4 })
  })
  w.sound(i % 2 ? 'crash' : 'zap')
  w.puff({ x: h.x + dx, y: top, z: h.z + dz, kind: 'star', color: c, count: 40, size: 0.25, speed: 5, up: 0, life: 1.5, gravity: 2 })
  w.puff({ x: h.x + dx, y: top, z: h.z + dz, kind: 'confetti', color: w.pick(cols), count: 25, size: 0.2, speed: 4, life: 1.5 })
  yield* me.jump(0.3)
}
yield* w.wait(0.6)
w.sound('yay')
me.feel('happy')
me.say({ en: 'Ooh! Fireworks!', fi: 'Oho! Ilotulitus!' })
yield* me.poseTo({ armL: { swing: 2.6, raise: 0.6 }, armR: { swing: 2.6, raise: 0.6 } }, 0.2)
yield* me.jump(0.5)
yield* me.rest()
